note: Generated by tools/t0/anim/tokens/make-skin-tokens.mjs from src/engine/skins/standards.spec.mjs (the source). Lengths are CSS px, colours #rrggbb, alphas 0..1.

tokens.name: color.union
tokens.doc: Union cloth.  Deep enough that the white numeral holds 5.6:1 on it, and edged in pale cream so it holds on dark woods too

tokens.name: color.confederate
tokens.doc: Confederate cloth.  Vermilion: the colour-blind-safe pair with the blue (Okabe and Ito in spirit), white numeral at 5.1:1

tokens.name: color.unknown
tokens.doc: Side UNKNOWN (10 ids whose id prefix and state code disagree, Contested): neutral pale cloth, hatched, never a side colour

tokens.name: color.unionBright
tokens.doc: Union in light: the strength bar, the selection ring, the carried-forward edge and the leader

tokens.name: color.confederateBright
tokens.doc: Confederate in light: the same uses

tokens.name: color.pole
tokens.doc: The pole and its finial: pale cream, the one hard light ink of the picture

tokens.name: color.poleEdge
tokens.doc: The dark line the pole and the flag edge stand on so they hold over pale ground (fields, roads)

tokens.name: pole.edgeAlpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the dark line a pole and a flag stand on: heavy enough that the mark holds 3:1 over a mid-tone field (the cream edge alone reaches about 3:1 there)

tokens.name: color.edge
tokens.doc: The thin edge of a fresh flag

tokens.name: color.glass
tokens.doc: The glass inside a carried-forward (hollow) flag

tokens.name: color.ink
tokens.doc: Lettering of unit codes and names

tokens.name: color.tintUnion
tokens.doc: Lettering of a Union formation or crowd

tokens.name: color.tintConfederate
tokens.doc: Lettering of a Confederate formation or crowd

tokens.name: color.tintUnknown
tokens.doc: Lettering of a formation of unknown side

tokens.name: color.tintMixed
tokens.doc: Lettering of a crowd of both sides

tokens.name: color.halo
tokens.doc: The dark halo behind every letter

tokens.name: color.select
tokens.doc: The selection ring of a mark of unknown side (a Union or Confederate mark is ringed in its own light colour)

tokens.name: color.numeral
tokens.doc: The count inside a crowd flag

tokens.name: color.numeralHalo
tokens.doc: Its halo (none by default: the cloth carries the contrast)

tokens.name: halo.width
tokens.doc: Width of the halo stroke behind lettering

tokens.name: halo.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the halo stroke

tokens.name: halo.soft
tokens.doc: Opacity of the second, wider halo that softens the first

tokens.name: text.dimAlpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of lettering when the mark is carried forward (1: it keeps its contrast; the hollow flag carries the age)

tokens.name: pole.width
tokens.doc: Width of a pole, the hard cream line a flag flies from

tokens.name: pole.unit
tokens.doc: Height of the pole of a regiment or battery below the full zoom (a small side-and-arm mark)

tokens.name: pole.unitFull
tokens.doc: Height of the pole of a regiment or battery from the full zoom (default 15)

tokens.name: pole.brigade
tokens.doc: Height of a brigade standard (and of a crowd of units under no formation)

tokens.name: pole.division
tokens.doc: Height of a division standard: the scale hierarchy is the pole and the flag, not a box

tokens.name: pole.corps
tokens.doc: Height of a corps (or army) standard

tokens.name: foot.r
tokens.doc: Radius of the foot of a pole: the unit stands exactly here

tokens.name: shadow.rx
tokens.doc: Half-width of the soft ground shadow under a standard (lit from the north-west, like the relief)

tokens.name: shadow.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of that shadow

tokens.name: flag.unitW
tokens.doc: Length of a regiment flag below the full zoom

tokens.name: flag.unitH
tokens.doc: Height of a regiment flag below the full zoom

tokens.name: flag.unitFullW
tokens.doc: Least length of a regiment flag from the full zoom: it lengthens to hold its short code, which stands on the cloth

tokens.name: flag.unitFullH
tokens.doc: Height of a regiment flag from the full zoom: the 12 px code stands on it with 3 px of plain cloth above and below (director fix 7: a clean ring round every numeral)

tokens.name: flag.brigadeW
tokens.doc: Length of a brigade flag

tokens.name: flag.brigadeH
tokens.doc: Height of a brigade flag

tokens.name: flag.divisionW
tokens.doc: Length of a division flag

tokens.name: flag.divisionH
tokens.doc: Height of a division flag

tokens.name: flag.corpsW
tokens.doc: Length of a corps flag

tokens.name: flag.corpsH
tokens.doc: Height of a corps flag

tokens.name: rank.pip
tokens.doc: Radius of a rank pip on a formation flag: one pip for a brigade, two for a division, three for a corps (derived from the order of battle, no insignia)

tokens.name: rank.pipGap
tokens.doc: Distance between the centres of two rank pips

tokens.name: flag.crowdMinH
tokens.doc: Least height of a crowd flag: tall enough for its 12 px numeral

tokens.name: flag.notch
tokens.doc: Depth of the swallow-tail of a cavalry flag and of the arrow end of an artillery flag, as a share of the flag height

tokens.name: flag.wave
tokens.doc: How far the cloth rises and falls along its length (px; none under 12 px of length): cloth, not a box

tokens.name: flag.shade
tokens.doc: Strength of the light-to-shade gradient along the cloth

tokens.name: flag.edge
tokens.doc: Width of the edge of a fresh flag

tokens.name: flag.edgeHollow
tokens.doc: Width of the light-side edge of a carried-forward flag

tokens.name: flag.gap
tokens.doc: Space between a flag and its lettering

tokens.name: flag.padX
tokens.doc: Space between the code or count and the flag edge, at each end: with the edge itself it leaves 3 px of plain cloth (director fix 7)

tokens.name: code.baseline
tokens.doc: Distance of a lettering baseline below the middle of the flag

tokens.name: name.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the grown-in full name

tokens.name: strength.bar
tokens.doc: Show the slim strength bar under a regiment flag from the full zoom (1) or not (0).  It is the placement strength over the unit reference: MODELLED, and not a casualty record

tokens.name: strength.h
tokens.doc: Height of the strength bar

tokens.name: strength.gap
tokens.doc: Space between the flag and the strength bar

tokens.name: strength.track
tokens.doc: Opacity of the dark track the bar runs on

tokens.name: detail.corpsNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a corps (and a crowd of one) says its name

tokens.name: detail.divisionNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a division says its name

tokens.name: detail.brigadeNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a brigade says its name

tokens.name: detail.crowdNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a crowd says what its units share (a number alone never stands for hidden units)

tokens.name: detail.fullZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a unit is a FULL mark (a taller pole, a larger flag, its short code, the strength bar); below it a small side-and-arm mark

tokens.name: detail.selectGrowZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a selected mark grows its flag and name (a unit inside a crowd steps out of it and stands on its own place); below it the selection is a ring and nothing moves (director fix 6)

tokens.name: detail.selectNameMinViewport
tokens.doc: A selected mark grows its full name only when the window is at least this wide (px); the default admits every phone: the sheet carries the card, the map still shows which mark it is about (director fix 6)

tokens.name: detail.unitNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a unit says its full name: the same mark grows, there is no second box

tokens.name: detail.hullZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a crowd shows the true positions of the units it stands for (while pointed at or selected)

tokens.name: carried.hollow
tokens.doc: How far a carried-forward flag hollows: 0 = no change, 1 = tinted glass with a light-side edge (the hue stays: never grey)

tokens.name: carried.glass
tokens.doc: Opacity of the glass inside a hollow flag

tokens.name: carried.tint
tokens.doc: How much of the side colour tints that glass

tokens.name: memory.enabled
tokens.doc: Draw the ground marks that remember the losses (1) or not (0)

tokens.name: memory.shape
tokens.doc: The mark: bar (a fallen figure) or cross

tokens.name: memory.len
tokens.doc: Length of a mark at the closest zoom (shorter when zoomed out)

tokens.name: memory.width
tokens.doc: Width of one ground mark (a fallen figure or a cross) at the closest zoom

tokens.name: memory.union
tokens.doc: Colour of a Union mark: a dark cloth blue

tokens.name: memory.confederate
tokens.doc: Colour of a Confederate mark: a dark cloth red-brown

tokens.name: memory.edge
tokens.doc: The pale edge that keeps a dark mark readable on dark ground (empty: none)

tokens.name: memory.edgeAlpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the pale or white edge under a ground mark

tokens.name: memory.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the ground marks that remember the losses

tokens.name: memory.fadeTicks
tokens.doc: Ticks over which a new mark settles on the ground

tokens.name: hull.dot
tokens.doc: Radius of the dot on the true position of one unit a crowd stands for (shown while the crowd is pointed at or selected)

tokens.name: hull.leader
tokens.doc: Opacity of the hairlines from a crowd to its units

tokens.name: hull.maxLen
tokens.doc: Longest hairline from a crowd to a member it stands for (px); a member further off shows its dot alone, so a crowd of scattered units does not throw a spider of lines across the map

tokens.name: pin.r
tokens.doc: Radius of the true-position ring

tokens.name: leader.width
tokens.doc: Width of the hairline from the true position to its mark

tokens.name: leader.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of that hairline

tokens.name: sel.rx
tokens.doc: Least half-width of the selection ellipse on the ground round the foot (it grows with the pole)

tokens.name: sel.ratio
tokens.doc: Height over width of that ellipse: a ring lying on the ground

tokens.name: sel.width
tokens.doc: Width of the selection ring, in the mark’s own light colour under a dark hairline

tokens.name: hover.width
tokens.doc: Width of the fainter hover ring

tokens.name: motion.selectMs
tokens.doc: Ease of the selection ring (critically damped)

tokens.name: motion.hoverMs
tokens.doc: Ease of the hover state
